literal_meaning: ঘূর্ণনের অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (whirring or spinning sound imitation)
figurative_meaning_en: the sense of spinning or whirling very fast
example_sentences_in_english: The fan is whirling round and round in the heat.
The wheel is spinning rapidly as it races ahead.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in Bengali to mimic rapid rotational motion, often associated with everyday objects like fans or wheels.
